description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers and supporting functions for analytics endpoints related to code contribution data. It includes endpoints to compute on-demand aggregated data (`/compute`), retrieve commits and PR metrics, dashboard summaries, active contributors, recent activity feeds, and merged PR counts per repository. The code interacts with a PostgreSQL database via SQLAlchemy, handles date ranges, and manages scope validation for organization and repositories.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model to parse and validate input for analytics computation, including org ID, optional repo ID, start date, and end date.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for the response of the analytics computation endpoint, reporting upsert counts and timestamps.

classes.name: DayCountPoint
classes.description: Represents daily count data, used for commits per day.

classes.name: PullRequestsDayPoint
classes.description: Represents daily PR opened and merged counts.

classes.name: DashboardMetricsResponse
classes.description: Aggregated response structure for the dashboard endpoint, includes multiple metrics and time series data.

classes.name: RepoCountPoint
classes.description: Represents count of merged PRs for a specific repository.

classes.name: RecentActivityItem
classes.description: Details a recent git event, including repo info, event type, actor, timestamps, and optional PR or commit info.

classes.name: ActiveContributorsResponse
classes.description: Response model providing the count of active contributors within a range.
